## Problem and resulting behavior

Describe the user problem and what this changes. Link an issue if relevant.

## Verification

List the focused check or practical workflow you actually ran and its result.
For UI changes, include a screenshot of the affected layout.
Distinguish source checks, runtime observation, listening and hardware evidence.

## Remaining limits

State anything unverified or any compatibility/data-recovery impact.

## Contribution checks

- [ ] The change is focused and preserves existing controls and waveform previews.
- [ ] No credentials, private media, profile backups or generated app bundles are included.
- [ ] New original code is contributed under MIT; third-party notices are retained.
